player.это уровневая система вознаграждений за:
is a tiered reward system for completing tasks within a specific time ('season'). The level increases with XP.

XP is the experience you get for each task. The more XP, the higher the level, and with each new level, you can claim new cool rewards!

There are two types of passes - regular and premium. The premium option is purchased with RedBucks and allows you to receive additional rewards for completing levels, while the regular one is absolutely free for everyone.

The Quest Chain is an additional branch of tasks, for completing which you can also get extra XP and rewards. Please note that completion is counted only if you have selected the task before completing it.
